author: ai
text: Russia's net exports of wheat are 39.6% of its production, and of potash 92.8% of its production (FAOSTAT, 2024). Its mines produce an estimated 43% of the world's palladium (USGS, 2025). Iran is the main supplier of Russia's major arms imports, at 51% (SIPRI, 2021–2025). Russia has 143.5 million people and a GDP of $2.56 trillion (World Bank, 2025).
